name: Richard's Sunday Soup
description: A rich and comforting soup featuring carrots, potatoes, and chicken stock.

recipeInstructions.text: Peel and dice the carrots and potato. Combine diced onion and oil in a saucepan and cook over medium heat.
Add the diced carrots and potato to the onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add chicken stock and sugar. Cook for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to simmer and cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until the vegetables are cooked.
Remove from heat and puree. Serve immediately with fresh bread.

keywords: carrot soup, potato soup, chicken stock

_similar.name: Veggie Basic Soup
_similar.description: A hearty vegetable soup made with a variety of vegetables and flavorful broth.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat. Cook onions, carrots, and celery until the onion is translucent.
Stir in tomatoes, beef broth, soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and flavors are well blended.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook vegetables (potatoes, carrots) in 6 cups water until tender, about 20 minutes.
Microwave onions and butter until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add the cooked onion and butter mixture to the vegetables and stir.
Make a roux by stirring flour into 1 cup water until smooth, then add to the soup.
Add more water (up to 1 more cup) to achieve desired consistency.

_similar.name: Creamy Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy and comforting broccoli soup made with potatoes, chicken broth, and a touch of Miracle Whip for richness.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large saucepan, bring chicken broth to a boil. Add potatoes and broccoli. Simmer for 10 minutes or until tender.
Purée the mixture in a blender until smooth.
Pour the puréed mixture back into the saucepan. Using a whisk, blend in Miracle Whip and seasonings.
Heat the soup thoroughly, stirring occasionally, until warmed through. Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: creamy broccoli soup, potato soup, comforting soup
